verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents Iceberg managed tables that keep data in customer-owned storage buckets in the open Iceberg format, readable by open-source and third-party engines. It also supports open table formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi) and can return query results in Apache Arrow. These give a real path to keeping data in open formats outside BigQuery, but they apply only to Iceberg tables and query results, not to all data. A community comment that migrating off takes months reflects lock-in concern but does not concretely contradict the documented export paths. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all standard tables to open file formats (e.g., Parquet/Avro/CSV extract jobs), a documented full-account exit or migration-off path, and independent hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
